title: Logo positioning
slide_intent: Tie logo size to canvas dimensions and placement to legibility. Those two judgments help a reader find the mark on surfaces with different shapes.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can keep consistent margins across formats while allowing the mark to move when the surrounding content requires it.
demonstration: The notes give the logo-width calculation as the sum of canvas width and height divided by 8.5. A portrait diagram emphasizes the upper-right position and shows three alternatives.
practical_value: Start with the specified size and the top-right corner. Use the symbol width to set margins and judge another position when the composition needs it.

content_islands.name: Sizing and placement guidance
content_islands.spec: Use two text columns for the sizing calculation and placement preferences. Keep the symbol-based reference beside them.

content_islands.name: Canvas diagram
content_islands.spec: Set the tall white page inside a green surround. Mark its width, height and inset positions, showing the preferred signature in black and alternate corners faintly.
